title: End-to-end comparison: DCLab rules, DCLab agent, and plain Qwen with locked Python on code replicas
request: Measure DCLab end to end (data in and model out) against the product's model alone given a locked Python box on code-generated replicas (ticket_routing and delivery_time), scored by code on an unseen future set with leak columns blank, plus pin gate_v1 before any live call and run two dev cases capped at EUR 0.50.
spec: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/e2e provides code-made cases (cases.py), fixed-model future scorer with time deltas (reference.py), macOS sandbox-exec Python box (sandbox.py), e2e_plain_agent prompt and model purpose with thinking stored, plain arm loop (plain.py), twin lane reader (dclab.py), code scorer (score.py), CLI runner (plan|rules|run), pinned e2e_gate_v1, and twin invented_tables marking.
plan: E1-E3: implement cases.py, reference.py, and sandbox.py with unit tests in tests/test_e2e_comparison.py.
E4: add dclab_rnd/prompts/e2e_plain_agent.md, register e2e_plain_agent alongside exam_plain, and run make agent-eval and make harness-eval.
E5-E7: implement plain.py, dclab.py, and score.py with unit tests.
E8: add optional invented_tables marking to dclab_rnd/twin/__init__.py (_run).
E9-E10: implement e2e CLI runner, pin gate_v1.json and gate_v1.sha256, verify tests, and commit before any live call.
E11: run free rules arm on 6 dev cases (E2E-001), run 2 live dev cases on qwen/qwen3.8-flash capped at EUR 0.50 (E2E-002), check thinking capture, and run python -m dclab_rnd.archive.
E12-E13: write evidence/campaigns/e2e_v1/RESULT_dev.md, update CLAUDE.md, write this record, rebuild sft-dev, verify final tests, commit, and push main and dev.

decisions.decision: Code-generated replicas for cases and unseen future test set
decisions.why: Avoids model-authored text rules and lets the future set blank post-event leak columns at prediction time.

decisions.decision: One fixed HistGradientBoosting reference scorer with pairwise datetime differences
decisions.why: Compares each arm's feature choices rather than estimator tuning while letting decision trees use time deltas.

decisions.decision: macOS sandbox-exec locked box failing closed without network, keys, or outside writes
decisions.why: Runs plain model Python scripts safely on the local machine.

decisions.decision: Pin gate_v1.json and gate_v1.sha256 in git before any live model call
decisions.why: Keeps held-out seeds (101 to 104) criteria fixed before seeing dev outcomes.

decisions.decision: Register e2e_plain_agent next to exam_plain with cell_values=0 and adaptive thinking
decisions.why: Stores plain-arm prompts, tool calls, and thinking whole while respecting model data limits.

change: Created dclab_rnd/agent_eval/e2e (cases, reference, sandbox, plain, dclab, score, __main__, gate_v1.json, gate_v1.sha256), dclab_rnd/prompts/e2e_plain_agent.md, and tests/test_e2e_comparison.py; registered e2e_plain_agent in settings.py, harness.py, sets/llm.py, and tests/test_model_data_limits.py; added invented_tables to dclab_rnd/twin/__init__.py; updated agent_eval and harness fingerprints; ran E2E-001 (rules) and E2E-002 (live dev); archived snapshot 20261118T205250Z; wrote RESULT_dev.md, CLAUDE.md, and this record.

findings.defect: ticket_routing prediction moment in multiclass.py differed from draft spec and Budget lived in conversation_exam rather than harness_ablation; test_model_data_limits also enumerates all PURPOSES.
findings.scenario: Preflight inspection of kinds/multiclass.py, harness_ablation/__init__.py, and test_model_data_limits.py during E1, E4, and E9.
findings.cause: Draft plan used an older phrasing for ticket_routing, referenced harness_ablation's re-used Budget helper, and did not list test_model_data_limits.py among purpose-enumerating test files.
findings.fix: Copied multiclass.py's exact moment into cases.py, imported Budget from conversation_exam in __main__.py, and added e2e_plain_agent to no_user_data in tests/test_model_data_limits.py.

findings.defect: The blind rules arm (workflow lane without a model) kept post-event leak columns in features and predicted outside the future-set interval in all 6 dev cases.
findings.scenario: Running E2E-001 (6 dev cases) and E2E-002 (2 dev cases) with blind=True left solution.forbidden empty and time_column unset on delivery_time, even when data notes flagged courier_rating and resolved_by as possible post-event columns.
findings.cause: Without a model acting on data-audit flags or specifying the prediction moment, the rules path keeps all non-identifier columns as features and treats order_time as an identifier.
findings.fix: Recorded the behavior in E2E-001_rules_dev.json, E2E-002_dev.json, and RESULT_dev.md without altering DCLab per plan.

findings.defect: TwinGateway does not emit model_exchanges files counted by harness_ablation.capture.
findings.scenario: Running harness_ablation.capture on E2E-002 returned 48 ok plain exchanges with thinking and 0 twin model_exchanges, even with invented_tables passed to twin.run.
findings.cause: TwinGateway records exchanges in ai_first/transcripts/model_calls.jsonl and ai_first/transcripts/thinking.jsonl rather than gateway model_exchanges JSONL files.
findings.fix: Verified that all 49 ok twin calls (21 delivery_time-s11 and 28 ticket_routing-s11) kept non-empty answer.thinking in model_calls.jsonl and thinking.jsonl, and documented the distinction without editing gateway.py.
findings.test: E11 capture check on E2E-002 plus inspection of ai_first/transcripts/model_calls.jsonl

findings.defect: Plain arm on delivery_time-s11 returned 32 engineered feature names rather than raw table column names, leaving only 3 raw columns scorable by reference.real_score and claiming MAE 6.5 against real 10.5572.
findings.scenario: finish tool call in E2E-002 listed distance, hour, te_rest, and derived terms instead of distance_km, order_time, and restaurant_id; both plain runs also wrote 5 numbers not matched verbatim in tool outputs and hit failing scripts (6/23 delivery_time, 4/23 ticket_routing).
findings.cause: reference.real_score intersects reported feature names with case.table.columns, and plain prose rounded or derived values relative to stdout text.
findings.fix: Recorded exact scores and call counts in E2E-002_dev.json and RESULT_dev.md without changing prompts or scorer.

outcome: Built and pinned the three-arm end-to-end comparison package, ran all 6 rules dev cases free (E2E-001) and 2 live dev cases on qwen/qwen3.8-flash for EUR 0.100322 (E2E-002), verified thinking capture across 48 plain exchanges and 49 twin calls, archived snapshot 20261118T205250Z, and wrote RESULT_dev.md without touching held-out seeds.
lessons: Scoring choices on an unseen future set with leaks blank exposes silent leak retention in blind rule runs that otherwise pass in-table holdout checks.

When a plain Python agent engineers new feature names instead of listing source table columns, reference scorers matching raw column names penalize its feature set unless raw inputs are requested or translated.
risks: Blind rules-only runs keep flagged leak suspects (courier_rating, resolved_by, first_response_minutes) in features today.
Held-out seeds 101 to 104 remain unrun until the owner reviews E2E-002 and RESULT_dev.md.
